01 OUR STORY

Football. Culture.
Lifestyle.

Matchday Nigeria exists for the fans who live the game every single day — not just on match day.

02 WHO WE ARE

Built by fans,
for fans.

Matchday Nigeria started with a simple idea: Nigerian football fans deserve easy access to the jerseys of the clubs and national teams they love, without the stress. From Old Trafford to the Camp Nou, from the Bernabéu to the Emirates — we bring the colours of the world's biggest clubs straight to your doorstep.

We stock Home, Away, Third and Special Edition kits, and every jersey comes in two fits — a true Player Edition cut for match day, and a relaxed Fan Edition for everyday wear.

· FAQ

Frequently asked
questions.

What's the difference between Player and Fan Edition?

Player Edition (₦20,000) is the true match-day cut worn by players — a slimmer, technical fit. Fan Edition (₦15,000) is a relaxed, everyday fit built for comfort.

What sizes do you stock?

All jerseys are available in M, L, XL and 2XL.

How do I complete my order?

Add your jerseys to the cart, choose edition and size, then tap "Continue on WhatsApp." Your order summary is sent straight to our chat, where we confirm final details and payment.

Do you deliver nationwide?

Yes — we deliver across Nigeria. Delivery time and cost are confirmed with you on WhatsApp based on your location.

Matchday Nigeria is a football culture & lifestyle brand — bringing you jerseys that carry the story of the game, on and off the pitch.
